newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close lower as inflation fears grip Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close lower as inflation fears grip Dow.

text.p: A sharp fall on Wall Street propelled UK shares sharply lower on Friday, as U.S. inflation data showed stronger-than-expected inflationary pressures and heightened fears of a near-term interest rate rise.
The FTSE 100 index closed 42.5 points lower at 4,270.7, wiping out the gains of the past two sessions and leaving the index up just 34.1 points on the week.

Deliners were in a near six-to-one majority, though trading volumes remained thin at just 635 million shares at the official close. Extending its decline of the past two sessions, the Dow was down 77 points as the London market closed.
